title: Map Picker
description: The map picker the host uses in the lobby to choose a ready-made layout or a random galaxy (with Re-roll), the read-only view for other players, and its loading, error and empty states.

shots.heading: Host: Standard selected
shots.caption: Six players: the host sees a strip of choices with Standard highlighted and marked Recommended, the large board below with the host's own seat ringed (you), the seat list, the summary line, Re-roll and Done.

shots.heading: Host: Random selected
shots.caption: Picking Random highlights its card and swaps the summary to Random map; the board is a freshly drawn galaxy and Re-roll stays available. (The Start preset control is a dev-build only extra.)

shots.heading: Host: after Re-roll
shots.caption: Re-roll on the Random map keeps the same choice but draws a different board: the home seats stay put while the systems between them have been reshuffled.

shots.heading: Another player: read-only
shots.caption: A non-host player (seat 2, ringed as you) sees only the title The table's map, the board, seats and summary: no choice strip, no Re-roll, and a Close button instead of Done.

shots.heading: Phone layout, 390 px
shots.caption: On a phone the sheet fills the screen: the choice strip scrolls sideways (cards are cut off at the edge), the board scales to the width and the footer wraps with Re-roll and Done still reachable.

shots.heading: Loading
shots.caption: Before anything has answered the strip shows four grey placeholder cards and the preview area says Loading the map; the summary already names the chosen map and the buttons stay in place.

shots.heading: Error: preview failed
shots.caption: The choice strip loaded, but the board request failed: a message names the failing request and a Retry button sits in the preview area; choosing and Done still work.

shots.heading: Empty: no layout for 7 players
shots.caption: With seven players the server lists no ready-made layouts, so the picker says so and offers only Random. Here a Random pick was rejected (the red error line is hidden behind the dialog) and the old board stays.

shots.heading: Lobby row before Start
shots.caption: Outside the picker, the lobby shows Map: 6pHyperlanes with a Choose map button above the seats, while Start game is still disabled; the host can reopen the picker until Start.
